title: Normalized integral immersion pullback presentations and comparison clauses
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme morphism g:Y→X. Use the recorded completed integral coefficient sheaves and their projection-normalized adic presentations. Define the inverse coefficient restriction back and its sectionwise identity round trip; the completed and finite coefficient inverse-image isomorphisms and their constant/projection/transition predicate; the ordinary module and derived inverse images; the strict completed pullback, its actual unit comparison, and finite projections. HasReductionInterval is containment of the support of every positive reduction in the given integer interval, allowing empty intervals. Comparison consists of the published integral comparison, completeness after back, the gamma isomorphism fixed by that comparison and the strict/reflector map, the actual completion isomorphism c with all projection and transition equations, one completed shift compatible with both comparisons, and exactness, constant-section linearity, constructibility and interval preservation. FinitePerfectQuotients specifies finite coefficient quotients and their augmented two-term finite-free resolutions. These are the existing declarations of lem-sf-integral-immersion-pullback-normalization, moved verbatim to a definition module and publicly reexported; no existence of Comparison is asserted.
